# React Native's Android autolinking adds a library's codegen directory and
# links react_codegen_<libraryName> (0.85 and 0.86 without checking that
# either exists), then links that library to its common_flags. Lucent has
# no codegen: its components' code is in lucentnative itself, the C++
# module autolinking also adds, so this library of one empty unit only
# stands for it.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)
add_library(react_codegen_lucentnative STATIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/codegen.cpp)
